args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing nightly test failures in tests/test_money.py.
Switch the quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-way cases round
to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` claimed banker's rounding in its docstring but implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.
- Switched `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` when quantizing to cents, per FIN-212.

## Behavior
- `2.675` → `2.68`
- `2.665` → `2.66` (classic banker's rounding half-way case)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (includes `tests/test_money.py`).

Fixes the nightly build failure for FIN-212.
